goal: Show academic readiness, program relevance, and a realistic career direction.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and what field you want to study.
Summarize relevant study, results, projects, and skills.
Show relevant experience that strengthens your case.
Explain modules, specialization, or academic content that matches your goals.
Mention faculty, facilities, ranking only if relevant, and course-specific strengths.
Describe short-term and long-term goals after completion.

red_flags: Writing too broadly instead of showing fit
banned_phrases: I have always wanted to go to the UK
I will do anything to get admitted
this is my way to stay in the UK
the visa is my main concern
preferred_language: My background in X has prepared me for...
This course aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum provides the specialization I need in...
I intend to develop expertise in...
After completing this course, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The course and university are named clearly
The document matches the CAS and supporting files
